text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer charges through the Arima 
Kinen. She trembles with the sheer 
fulfillment of having returned to the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spotlighted Oguri Cap also put up an 
impressive performance despite the immense 
pressure. The Trainer learns that she had 
channeled that pressure into strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer declared that she, too, 
would gain the strength to overcome any 
pressure.
